Review complete. Checked all four documents, cross-checked the fresh figures against the ledger's integration records, and verified scope via `git status`/`git diff --stat`/file mtimes (no files edited, no long commands).

Findings:

1. Fresh vs historical distinction — clean. `.team/audit.md` keeps the 2026-10-24 historical section intact and adds a labeled "FRESH EVIDENCE — 2026-10-27 (Hermes GUI)" section (line 57) that explicitly supersedes the historical part on conflict. `REMAINING_GAPS.md` has a "Historical versus fresh" section naming `docs/QA_REPORT.md`, `docs/PHASE_REPORT.md`, and the old audit section as historical, and restricts the register to command/exit-code evidence. `CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md` is header-dated 2026-10-27 and titled "fresh Hermes GUI evidence".

2. Exact fresh results preserved, consistent across all documents:
- P1–P5 PASS: `.team/audit.md:63` (15/15, 9/9, 13/13, 15/15, 11/11, exit 0 each) matches `CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:15-19` and matches the ledger's past integration entries (e.g. task-005/006/007 lines).
- Build PASS with Node warning: `.team/audit.md:64` and `CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:20` (exit 0; Node 22.11.0 below Vite 22.12+ floor); REMAINING_GAPS.md:13 carries it as a BLOCKED gap.
- Backend: exactly 404 tests / 3 failures — `.team/audit.md:65` and `CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:21`, with the same three named tests in both (audit.md:70, CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:28-30: the admin auth regression + two SIGNAL_WEAK-vs-CURRENT Daily Radar failures).
- SQLite REAL=3 / SAMPLE=21 across 13 tables — audit.md:66 and CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:22 agree; per-table detail (articles 1/1, raw_items 1/1, sources 1/2) is illustrative and sums consistently.
- Browser E2E NOT_VERIFIED — audit.md:67, CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:23-24 (E2E and public/private proof both NOT_VERIFIED), REMAINING_GAPS.md:7-8.

3. No release-readiness claim anywhere. `CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:9` explicitly says "chưa thể gọi release candidate"; REMAINING_GAPS.md holds every gap at FAIL/NOT_VERIFIED/BLOCKED.

4. Scope integrity verified: `git diff --stat` shows only the 18 pre-existing dirty product files (mtimes 2026-10-24/25, predating the 2026-10-27 write-up); `checks/`, `PLAN.md`, `docs/MISSION.md` do not appear in git status at all; the four audit docs are the only 2026-10-27 artifacts; `.team/audit.md:59` states reference project `Vu-Agent-Room-PC` untouched, and `CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:34` makes the no-change claim matching the observed git state.

Minor, non-blocking: `.team/ledger.md:290` honestly discloses the coordinator finished the write-up after the GUI session stopped emitting, and the audit's SQLite per-table note covers only 3 of 13 tables (totals remain exact).

VERDICT: APPROVED — fresh-vs-historical separation is explicit in .team/audit.md:57 and REMAINING_GAPS.md:19-21; exact fresh results preserved (.team/audit.md:61-70: P1–P5 15/9/13/15/11 PASS, build PASS w/ Node 22.11 warning, 404 tests/3 named failures, REAL=3/SAMPLE=21, E2E NOT_VERIFIED), no release-readiness claim (CURRENT_PROGRESS_AUDIT.md:9), and git status/diff + mtimes confirm no source/checks/PLAN/MISSION/reference-project changes — only the four dated 2026-10-27 audit docs plus pre-existing dirty product files.
